title.zh: 立体几何 · 转一转，再切一刀
title.en: Solid Geometry · Turn It, Then Cut It

desc.zh: 把立方体转到不同角度看，用平面一刀切下去，截面从三角形变成六边形；体积与表面积怎样随尺寸变化，展开图又能不能折回立方体。
desc.en: View a cube from different angles, then slice it with a plane and watch the cross-section go from triangle to hexagon; see how surface area and volume scale and whether a net folds back into a cube.
